reason: They don't say who the payment company is, what the fee per transaction is, or when the money lands in my account, and that's the first thing I need to know. I'm two waiters short. I'm not putting QR codes on the tables and teaching the staff something new when I can't see what it costs me on every bill.
objection: The per-transaction fee is charged on top and nobody tells me how much, and I don't know when I get paid. On a café's margins, a hidden percentage on every bill could eat more than the 59 GEL.
would_change_my_mind: The payment partner named, with the exact fee per transaction and next-day payout to my bank written down, at or below what my card terminal costs me now.
